entities.summary: Richard M. Roberts is an American former law enforcement officer and disbarred attorney. Roberts worked as a detective in the Essex County Prosecutor’s Office and the Essex County Bureau of Narcotics. After completing law school at Seton Hall University and passing the bar examination, Roberts served as an Assistant Prosecutor in the Essex County Prosecutor's Office.
